lines.line: 1 - 1.25kg (2 - 2.5lb) large bone-in skin-on thighs (4 - 5 pieces) (, ~220-250g / 7 - 8 oz each (Note 1))
1 tbsp olive oil
1 1/2 tsp paprika (, regular/sweet)
1/2 tsp garlic powder
1/2 tsp onion powder (, or more garlic powder)
1 tsp dried thyme (, crushed with fingers)
1 tsp cooking salt / kosher salt (halve for table salt, double for flakes)
1/4 tsp black pepper
600g/ 20oz baby potatoes (, skin on, cut into 1.75 cm / 0.7" pieces (Note 2))
3 carrots (, peeled, cut into 7mm / 1/3" thick coins (consider halving very big rounds into half moons))
1 large red onion (, cut into 1cm / 0.4" thick wedges)
2 garlic cloves (, crushed with garlic crusher or finely minced with a knife)
1 1/2 tbsp olive oil
1 tsp cooking salt / kosher salt (halve for table salt, double for flakes)
1/4 tsp black pepper
1/3 cup plain flour / all-purpose flour
2 1/2 cups beef stock/broth (, low sodium (yes, beef, not chicken! Note 3))
1 tsp dark soy *secret ingredient* (, optional, to make gravy rich brown plus deepens flavour, or use gravy browner (Note 4))
1/2 tsp black pepper
1 cup frozen peas (, leave out to thaw while chicken is baking)
1 tsp thyme leaves (, for sprinkling (100% optional))
